The device, hailed as five years ahead of its time, has since sold over 2 billion units globally, solidifying its place in tech history.
title: Quote of the day by Steve Jobs: What Apple founder said when he introduced iPhone

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: India faces a significant setback as all-rounder Washington Sundar is ruled out of the remaining ODIs against New Zealand due to a side strain. This injury casts doubt on his availability for the upcoming T20 series, adding to team concerns ahead of the T20 World Cup. The BCCI is expected to announce his replacement shortly.
title: Washington Sundar ruled out of ODI series due to injury

description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Ahmedabad for his first official visit to India, joining Prime Minister Narendra Modi at the International Kite Festival. The leaders also paid respects at Sabarmati Ashram. Discussions are set to focus on strengthening bilateral cooperation across various sectors, including trade, technology, and defense, building on the 25-year-old strategic partnership.
title: Watch: PM Modi kicks off International Kite Festival; shares kite-flying moment with German Chancellor

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: US President Donald Trump stated Washington is monitoring Iran's deadly protests and considering military retaliation, warning of unprecedented strikes if attacked. Iran's President accused the US and Israel of fomenting unrest, while the UN urged an end to the violent crackdown and restoration of internet access. Activists report over 544 deaths and thousands detained amid escalating violence.

description: Congress leader Mani Shankar Aiyar stated that Hindutva is "Hinduism in paranoia," arguing it incites fear among Hindus towards Muslims. He contrasted this with Hinduism, calling it a spiritual religion that has thrived for millennia without Hindutva's protection. BJP leader Sudhanshu Trivedi countered that Hindutva represents the core essence of Hinduism, or 'Hindu tattva,' and cherishing Hinduism is Hindutva.

description: Calling the BMC polls the "last election for the Marathi man", Thackeray said: "If you miss this opportunity today, you will be finished.
